units.title: Относительные придаточные: who/which/that
units.shortDescription: The man who lives next door — как соединять предложения красиво.
units.theoryHtml:
Относительные местоимения who (люди), which (предметы), that (и то и другое) соединяют два предложения в одно, заменяя повтор: I met a man. He lives next door. → I met a man who lives next door.

О ком/чёмМестоимениеПример
человекwho / thatThe woman who called you is my boss.
предметwhich / thatThe book which I bought is great.
животноеwhich / thatThe dog that barks is ours.
местоwhereThe café where we met closed.

Местоимение стоит сразу после определяемого слова: The film that we watched was long (не The film was long that we watched).

⚠ Частые ошибки: the man which lives... → who/that. Двойное подлежащее: The film that it was long → The film that was long. Пропуск who при подлежащем: The man lives next door is my boss → нужен who.

Мини-диалог:
— Who's that woman? — Which one? The one who is wearing red?
— No, the one that is talking to John. — That's Ann, the girl who organised the party.

exercises.prompt: The man ___ lives next door is a pilot.
The book ___ I read was fascinating.
The girl ___ won the prize is my cousin.
The car ___ he bought is red.
People ___ complain all the time annoy me.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: The film that it won the prize is long.
The film that won the prize is long.
The film who won the prize is long.
The film won the prize is long.

exercises.prompt: I like people ___ are honest.
The company ___ produces these phones is Korean.
The café ___ (где) we met has closed.
The man ___ (которого) I saw was tall.

units.title: whose/where/why в придаточных
units.theoryHtml:
whose — «чей» (принадлежность): That's the man whose dog bit me (его собака). Не путать с who's = who is!

where — «где» (место): This is the hotel where we stayed. Заменяет in which: the hotel in which we stayed — формально то же.

why — «почему» (причина): That's the reason why I called (why часто опускают).

Вопрос → придаточноеПример
Whose car is it? → the man whose car...the woman whose bag was stolen
Where did you stay? → the hotel where...the city where I was born
Why did he leave? → the reason why...the reason why he left

⚠ Частые ошибки: the man who's car... → whose (who's = who is!). the hotel where we stayed in → либо where we stayed, либо which we stayed in — не вместе.

Мини-диалог:
— Is this the house where Sherlock lived? — The very one. And whose statue is that outside? — Holmes's, of course. That's the reason why tourists come here.

exercises.prompt: That's the woman ___ husband works with me.
This is the town ___ I was born.
The reason ___ he resigned is still unknown.
A dictionary is a book ___ gives you definitions.
The boy ___ bicycle was stolen is crying.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: The café where we met in has closed.
The café which we met has closed.
The café where we met has closed.
The café whose we met has closed.
exercises.explanation: where мы встретились — без лишнего in.

exercises.prompt: Do you know a shop ___ sells vintage records?
The actor ___ films I love retired.
The restaurant ___ ___ (в котором) we ate was expensive. (2 слова)
That's the author ___ (чей) book changed my life.

units.title: Опущение that/who/which
units.shortDescription: The people we met — когда слово можно не писать.
units.theoryHtml:
Относительное местоимение можно опустить, когда оно — дополнение придаточного: The book (that) I read was great — «я прочитал книгу», that не подлежащее. Когда оно — подлежащее, опускать нельзя: The man who lives next door (who = подлежащее, живёт).

ТипОпускать?Пример
who/that — подлежащееНЕТThe man who called is my boss.
who/that — дополнениеДАThe man (who) I called is my boss.
which/that — подлежащееНЕТThe bus which goes downtown is late.
which/that — дополнениеДАThe bus (which) I take is late.
whoseНЕТThe girl whose bag was stolen.

Тест: что идёт сразу после местоимения? Если глагол — это подлежащее, не опускай. Если подлежащее (he, she, the bus) — можно опустить.

⚠ Частые ошибки: The man lives next door is my boss → нужен who. The people who I met — верно, но разговорно лучше the people I met.

Мини-диалог:
— Who's that? — The man who helped me yesterday. — The one you told me about? — Exactly. The story I told you is about him.

exercises.prompt: The film ___ we watched was boring. Можно ли опустить that?
The film ___ won an award is fantastic. Можно ли опустить?
The people ___ live here are friendly. Вставь слово:
The letter ___ arrived yesterday made me happy.
The song ___ you recommended is great. Вставь при желании:
Choose the correct sentence:
options: The woman works here is my aunt.
The woman who works here is my aunt.
The woman works here who is my aunt.
The woman which works here is my aunt.

exercises.prompt: The man ___ I told you about is here. Опущение:
exercises.explanation: I told you about him — man дополнение.

exercises.prompt: Where's the book ___ I gave you? Опущение:
Everything ___ he says is true.
The train ___ goes to Berlin leaves at six.
